ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel base with high-intensity (white) localized clusters. Estimated 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density distribution of high-intensity white circular clusters (mottling/scars) against a dark background. Clusters are concentrated on the distal regions of both lobes, with a higher frequency of contiguous white blobs along the leading edges and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression at the center-line; approximate pixel-angle of 135 degrees with a shallow vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated profile along the entire trailing boundary. High-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (2-5 pixels) visible against the water-sky interface, particularly on the outer third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extreme density of localized circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) distributed across both lobes, consistent with high-frequency barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the left lobe, trending diagonally from the leading edge toward the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive systemic white circular scarring (rosettes) across approximately 70% of the visible fluke surface.
